And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal - And will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups (that) are (of) crystal
Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes). Crystal-clear of silver They will determine its measure
And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabîl (ginger), And they will be given to drink therein a cup is its mixture (of) Zanjabil
A spring there, called Salsabîl. A spring therein named Salsabil

And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls. And will circulate among them young boys made eternal When you see them you would think them (to be) pearls scattered
And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion. And when you look then you will see blessings and a kingdom great

Their garments will be of fine green silk, and gold embroidery. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink. Upon them (will be) garments (of) fine silk green and heavy brocade And they will be adorned (with) bracelets of silver and will give them to drink their Lord a drink pure
(And it will be said to them): "Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted." Indeed this is for you a reward and has been your effort appreciated
Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’ân to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) by stages. Indeed, We [We] [We] revealed to you the Quran progressively

Therefore be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with constancy to the Command of your Lord (Allâh, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them. So be patient for (the) Command (of) your Lord and (do) not obey from them any sinner or disbeliever
And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers]. And remember (the) name (of) your Lord morning and evening

And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Ishâ’ prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer). And of the night prostrate to Him and glorify Him a night long
Verily, these (disbelievers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard). Indeed these love the immediate and leave behind them a Day grave

It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong built. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement. We created them and We strengthened their forms and when We will We can change their likeness[es] (with) a change
Verily, this (Verse of the Qur’ân) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allâh). Indeed this (is) a reminder so whoever wills let him take to his Lord a way
But you cannot will, unless Allâh wills. Verily, Allâh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise. And not you will except that wills Allah Indeed Allah is All-Knower All-Wise

He will admit to His Mercy whom He wills and as for the Zâlimûn - (polytheists, wrong-doers) He has prepared a painful torment. He admits whom He wills into His mercy but (for) the wrongdoers He has prepared for them a punishment painful
By the winds (or angels or the Messengers of Allâh) sent forth one after another. By the ones sent forth one after another
And by the winds that blow violently. And the winds that blow violently
And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain. And the ones that scatter far and wide
And by the Verses (of the Qur’ân) that separate the right from the wrong. And those who separate (by the) Criterion
And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers, And those who bring down (the) Reminder
To cut off all excuses or to warn. (As) justification or warning
Surely, what you are promised must come to pass. Indeed, what you are promised will surely occur
Then when the stars lose their lights. So when the stars are obliterated
And when the heaven is cleft asunder. And when the heaven is cleft asunder
And when the mountains are blown away. And when the mountains are blown away
And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed. And when the Messengers are gathered to their appointed time
For what Day are these signs postponed? For what Day are (these) postponed
For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell). For (the) Day (of) Judgment
And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out? And what will make you know what (is the) Day (of) the Judgment
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
Did We not destroy the ancients? Did not We destroy the former (people)
So shall We make later generations to follow them. Then We follow them up (with) the later ones
Thus do We deal with the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals). Thus We deal with the criminals
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
Did We not create you from a despised water (semen)? Did not We create you from a water despicable
Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb), Then We placed it in an abode safe
For a known period (determined by gestation)? For a period known
So We did measure; and We are the Best to measure (the things). So We measured and Best (are We to) measure
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
Have We not made the earth a receptacle Have not We made the earth a receptacle
For the living and the dead? (For the) living and (the) dead
And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains, and have given you to drink sweet water? And We made therein firmly set mountains lofty and We gave you to drink water sweet
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
(It will be said to the disbelievers): "Depart you to that which you used to deny! Proceed to what you used to in it deny
"Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-Fire smoke ascending) in three columns, Proceed to a shadow having three columns
Neither shady, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire." No cool shade and not availing against the flame
Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr (a fort or a huge log of wood), Indeed, it throws up sparks as the fortress
As if they were yellow camels or bundles of ropes. As if they (were) camels yellow
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it), This (is) a Day not they will speak
And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse. And not will it be permitted for them to make excuses
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together! This (is the) Day (of) Judgment We have gathered you and the former (people)
So if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allâh جل جلاله)! So if is for you a plan then plan against Me
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs. Indeed the righteous (will be) in shades and springs
And fruits, such as they desire. And fruits from what they desire
"Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do." Eat and drink (in) satisfaction for what you used to do
Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112). Indeed, We thus reward the good-doers
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers

(O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals). Eat and enjoy yourselves a little indeed, you (are) criminals
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself (in prayer)!" They bow not down (offer not their prayers). And when it is said to them Bow not they bow
Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)! Woe that Day to the deniers
Then in what statement after this (the Qur’ân) will they believe? Then in what statement after it will they believe
What are they asking (one another) about? About what are they asking one another
About the great news, (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism, the Qur’ân, which Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم brought and the Day of Resurrection) About the News the Great
About which they are in disagreement. (About) which they (are) concerning it (in) disagreement
Nay, they will come to know! Nay (soon) they will know
Nay, again, they will come to know! Then Nay (soon) they will know
Have We not made the earth as a bed, Have not We made the earth a resting place
And the mountains as pegs? And the mountains (as) pegs
And We have created you in pairs (male and female, tall and short, good and bad, etc.). And We created you (in) pairs
And We have made your sleep as a thing for rest. And We made your sleep (for) rest
And We have made the night as a covering (through its darkness), And We made the night (as) covering
And We have made the day for livelihood. And We made the day (for) livelihood
And We have built above you seven strong (heavens), And We constructed over you seven strong
And We have made (therein) a shining lamp (sun). And We placed a lamp burning
And We have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water. And We sent down from the rain clouds water pouring abundantly
That We may produce therewith corn and vegetations, That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
And gardens of thick growth. And gardens (of) thick foliage
Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time, Indeed (the) Day (of) the Judgment is an appointed time

The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds (groups after groups). [Tafsir At-Tabari] (The) Day (in which) shall be blown in the trumpet and you will come forth (in) crowds
And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates, And is opened the heaven and becomes gateways
And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage. And are moved the mountains and become a mirage
Truly, Hell is a place of ambush - Indeed Hell is lying in wait

A dwelling place for the Tâghûn (those who transgress the boundary limits set by Allâh like polytheists, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, hyprocrites, sinners, criminals), For the transgressors a place of return
They will abide therein for ages. (They will) be remaining therein (for) ages
Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink. Not they will taste therein coolness and not any drink
Except boiling water, and dirty wound discharges - Except scalding water and purulence
An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes). A recompense appropriate
For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning. Indeed, they were not expecting an account
But they belied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم brought) completely. And they denied Our Signs (with) denial
And all things We have recorded in a Book. And every thing We have enumerated it (in) a Book
So taste you (the results of your evil actions). No increase shall We give you, except in torment. So taste and never We will increase you except (in) punishment
Verily, for the Muttaqûn, there will be a success (Paradise); Indeed for the righteous (is) success
Gardens and vineyards, Gardens and grapevines
And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age, And splendid companions well-matched
And a full cup (of wine). And a cup full
No Laghw (dirty, false, evil talk) shall they hear therein, nor lying; Not they will hear therein any vain talk and not any falsehood
A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (according to the best of their good deeds), (As) a reward from your Lord a gift (according to) account

(From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom they cannot dare to speak (on the Day of Resurrection except by His Leave). Lord (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between both of them the Most Gracious not they have power from Him (to) address

The Day that Ar-Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom the Most Gracious (Allâh) allows, and he will speak what is right. (The) Day will stand the Spirit and the Angels (in) rows not they will speak except (one) who permits [for] him the Most Gracious and he (will) say (what is) correct

That is (without doubt) the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)! That (is) the Day the True So whoever wills let him take towards his Lord a return

Verily, We have warned you of a near torment - the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!" Indeed We [We] have warned you (of) a punishment near (the) Day will see the man what have sent forth his hands and will say the disbeliever O I wish I were dust
By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence. By those who extract violently
By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers). And those who draw out gently
And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits). And those who glide swimming
And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses). And those who race each other (in) a race
And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account). And those who arrange (the) matter
On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die). (The) Day will quake the quaking one
The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be resurrected). Follows it the subsequent
(Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety. Hearts that Day will palpitate
Their eyes will be downcast. Their eyes humbled
They say: "Shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state of life? They say Will we indeed be returned to the former state
"Even after we are crumbled bones?" What! When we are bones decayed
They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!" They say This then (would be) a return losing
But it will be only a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)], (See Verse 37:19). Then only it (will be) a shout single
When behold, they find themselves on the surface of the earth alive after their death, And behold They (will be) awakened
Has there come to you the story of Mûsâ (Moses)? Has (there) come to you (the) story (of) Musa
When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tûwâ, When called him his Lord in the valley the sacred (of) Tuwa
Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he has transgressed all bounds (in crimes, sins, polytheism, disbelief). Go to Firaun Indeed, he (has) transgressed
And say to him: "Would you purify yourself (from the sin of disbelief by becoming a believer)?" And say Would [for] you [to] [that] purify yourself
"And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him?" And I will guide you to your Lord so you would fear
Then [Mûsâ (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles). Then he showed him the sign the great
But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] belied and disobeyed. But he denied and disobeyed
Then he turned his back, striving (against Allâh). Then he turned his back striving
Then he gathered (his people) and cried aloud, And he gathered and called out
Saying: "I am your lord, most high." Then he said I am your Lord the Most High
So Allâh, seized him with punishment for his last and first transgression. [Tafsir At-Tabari] So seized him Allah (with) an exemplary punishment (for) the last and the first
Verily, in this is an instructive admonition for whosoever fears Allâh. Indeed in that surely (is) a lesson for whoever fears
Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven that He constructed? Are you a more difficult creation or the heaven He constructed it
He raised its height, and has perfected it. He raised its ceiling and proportioned it
Its night He covers with darkness and its forenoon He brings out (with light) And He darkened its night and brought out its brightness
And after that He spread the earth, And the earth after that He spread it
And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture. He brought forth from it its water and its pasture
And the mountains He has fixed firmly, And the mountains He made them firm
(To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle. (As) a provision for you and for your cattle
But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense) - But when comes the Overwhelming Calamity the great
The Day when man shall remember what he strove for. (The) Day will remember man what he strove (for)
And Hell-fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees. And will be made manifest the Hellfire to (him) who sees
Then for him who transgressed all bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allâh). Then as for (him) who transgressed
And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts), And preferred the life (of) the world
Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire; Then indeed the Hellfire it (is) the refuge

But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires and lusts. But as for (him) who feared standing (before) his Lord and restrained his soul from the vain desires
Verily, Paradise will be his abode. Then indeed Paradise it (is) the refuge
They ask you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about the Hour - when will be its appointed time? They ask you about the Hour when (is) its arrival
You have no knowledge to say anything about it. In what (are) you [of] (to) mention it
To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof? To your Lord (is) its finality
You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are only a warner for those who fear it, Only you (are) a warner (for him) who fears it

The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning. As though they (the) Day they see it not they had remained except an evening or a morning thereof
(The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم) frowned and turned away. He frowned and turned away

Because there came to him the blind man (i.e. ‘Abdullâh bin Umm-Maktûm, who came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs). Because came to him the blind man
And how can you know that he might become pure (from sins)? But what would make you know that he might purify himself
Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him? Or be reminded so would benefit him the reminder
As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient, As for (him) who considers himself free from need
To him you attend; So you to him give attention
What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allâh). And not upon you that not he purifies himself
But as to him who came to you running, But as for (he) who came to you striving
And is afraid (of Allâh and His punishment). While he fears
Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another, But you from him (are) distracted
Nay, (do not do like this); indeed it (this Qur’ân) is an admonition. Nay Indeed, it (is) a reminder
So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it. So whosoever wills may remember it
(It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz), In sheets honored
Exalted (in dignity), purified, Exalted purified
In the hands of scribes (angels). In (the) hands (of) scribes
Honourable and obedient. Noble dutiful
Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is! Is destroyed [the] man how ungrateful is he
From what thing did He create him? From what thing He created him
From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him and then set him in due proportion. From a semen-drop He created him then He proportioned him
Then He makes the Path easy for him. Then the way He made easy for him
Then He causes him to die and puts him in his grave. Then He causes him to die and provides a grave for him
Then when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again). Then when He wills He will resurrect him
Nay, but (man) has not done what He commanded him. Nay Not he has accomplished what He commanded him
Then let man look at his food: Then let look the man at his food
We pour forth water in abundance. That [We] [We] poured the water (in) abundance
And We split the earth in clefts. Then We cleaved the earth splitting
And We cause therein the grain to grow, Then We caused to grow therein grain
And grapes and clover plants (i.e. green fodder for the cattle), And grapes and green fodder
And olives and date-palms, And olive and date-palms
And gardens dense with many trees, And gardens (of) thick foliage
And fruits and herbage And fruits and grass
(To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle. (As) a provision for you and for your cattle
Then when there comes As-Sâkhkhah (the second blowing of the Trumpet on the Day of Resurrection) But when comes the Deafening Blast
That Day shall a man flee from his brother, (The) Day will flee a man from his brother
And from his mother and his father, And his mother and his father
And from his wife and his children. And his wife and his children
Everyman that Day will have enough to make him careless of others. For every man among them that Day (will be) a matter occupying him
Some faces that Day will be bright (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism), Faces that Day (will be) bright
Laughing, rejoicing at good news (of Paradise). Laughing rejoicing at good news
And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained. And faces that Day upon them (will be) dust
Darkness will cover them. Will cover them darkness

Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers). Those [they] (are) the disbelievers the wicked ones
When the sun is wound round and its light is lost and is overthrown. When the sun is wrapped up
And when the stars fall. And when the stars fall, losing their luster
And when the mountains are made to pass away; And when the mountains are moved away
And when the pregnant she-camels are neglected; And when the full-term she-camels (are) left untended
And when the wild beasts are gathered together. And when the wild beasts are gathered
And when the seas become as blazing Fire or overflow. And when the seas are made to overflow
And when the souls are joined with their bodies, (the good with the good and the bad with the bad). And when the souls are paired
And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) is questioned: And when the female infant buried alive is asked
For what sin, was she killed? For what sin she was killed
And when the (written) pages [of deeds (good and bad) of every person] are laid open. And when the pages are laid open
And when the heaven is stripped off and taken away from its place; And when the sky is stripped away
And when Hell-fire is set ablaze. And when the Hellfire is set ablaze
And when Paradise is brought near. And when Paradise is brought near
(Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil). Will know a soul what it has brought
So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night). But nay I swear by the retreating planets
And by the planets that move swiftly and hide themselves. Those that run (and) disappear
And by the night as it departs. And the night when it departs
And by the dawn as it brightens. And the dawn when it breathes

Verily, this is the Word (this Qur’ân brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrîl (Gabrîl), from Allâh to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]. Indeed, it (is) surely a word (of) a Messenger noble
Owner of power, (and high rank) with (Allâh), the Lord of the Throne, Possessor of power with (the) Owner of the Throne secure
Obeyed (by the angels in the heavens), and trustworthy. One to be obeyed and trustworthy
And (O people) your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is not a madman. And not (is) your companion mad
And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east). And certainly he saw him in the horizon the clear
And he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen. And not he (is) on the unseen a withholder
And it (the Qur’ân) is not the word of the outcast Shaitân (Satan). And not it (is the) word (of) Shaitaan accursed
Then where are you going? So where are you going
Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn) Not it (is) except a reminder to the worlds
To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight. For whoever wills among you to take a straight way
And you cannot will unless (it be) that Allâh wills - the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists). And not you will except that wills Allah Lord (of) the worlds
When the heaven is cleft asunder. When the sky (is) cleft asunder
And when the stars have fallen and scattered. And when the stars scatter
And when the seas are burst forth. And when the seas are made to gush forth
And when the graves are turned upside down (and bring out their contents) And when the graves are overturned
(Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds). Will know a soul what it has sent forth and left behind
O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous? O man What has deceived you concerning your Lord the Most Noble
Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion. Who created you then fashioned you then balanced you
In whatever form He willed, He put you together. In whatever form what He willed He assembled you
Nay! But you deny Ad-Dîn (i.e. the Day of Recompense). Nay But you deny the Judgment
But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you, And indeed over you (are) surely guardians
Kirâman (Honourable) Kâtibîn writing down (your deeds), Noble recording
They know all that you do. They know whatever you do
Verily, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise); Indeed the righteous (will be) surely in bliss
And verily, the Fujjâr (the wicked, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners and evil-doers) will be in the blazing Fire (Hell), And indeed the wicked (will be) surely in Hellfire
Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense, They will burn (in) it (on the) Day (of) the Judgment
And they (Al-Fujjâr) will not be absent therefrom. And not they from it (will be) absent
And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is? And what can make you know what (is the) Day (of) the Judgment
Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is? Then what can make you know what (is the) Day (of) the Judgment

(It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allâh. (The) Day not will have power a soul for a soul anything and the Command that Day (will be) with Allah
Woe to Al-Mutaffifûn (those who give less in measure and weight). Woe to those who give less
Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure, Those who when they take a measure from the people they take in full
And when they have to give by measure or weight to (other) men, give less than due. But when they give by measure (to) them or they weigh (for) them they give less
Do they not think that they will be resurrected (for reckoning), Do not think those that they (will be) resurrected
On a Great Day? For a Day Great
The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)? (The) Day will stand mankind before (the) Lord (of) the worlds

Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the Fujjâr (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, evil-doers and the wicked) is (preserved) in Sijjîn. Nay Indeed (the) record (of) the wicked (is) surely in Sijjin
And what will make you know what Sijjîn is? And what can make you know what (is) Sijjin
A Register inscribed. A book written
Woe, that Day, to those who deny. Woe that Day to the deniers
Those who deny the Day of Recompense. Those who deny (the) Day (of) the Judgment
And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allâh) the sinner! And not can deny [of] it except every transgressor sinful
When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!" When are recited to him Our Verses he says Stories (of) the former (people)
Nay! But on their hearts is the Rân (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn. Nay But (the) stain has covered [over] their hearts (for) what they used to earn
Nay! Surely they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day. Nay Indeed, they from their Lord that Day surely will be partitioned
Then, verily, they will indeed enter (and taste) the burning flame of Hell. Then indeed, they (surely) will burn (in) the Hellfire
Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!" Then it will be said This (is) what you used to [of it] deny

Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyûn Nay Indeed (the) record (of) the righteous (will be) surely in Illiyin
And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyûn is? And what can make you know what (is) Illiyun
A Register inscribed, A book written
To which bear witness those nearest (to Allâh, i.e. the angels). Witness it those brought near
Verily, Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise). Indeed the righteous (will be) surely in bliss
On thrones, looking (at all things). On thrones observing
You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight. You will recognize in their faces (the) radiance (of) bliss
They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine. They will be given to drink of a pure wine sealed

The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of Musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah). Its seal (will be of) musk And for that let aspire the aspirers
It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnîm: And its mixture (is) of Tasneem
A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allâh. A spring will drink from it those brought near
Verily, (during the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed. Indeed those who committed crimes used to at those who believed laugh
And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery). And when they passed by them they winked at one another
And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting; And when they returned to their people they would return jesting
And when they saw them, they said: "Verily these have indeed gone astray!" And when they saw them they said Indeed these surely have gone astray
But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers). But not they had been sent over them (as) guardians
But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers So today those who believed at the disbelievers they will laugh
On (high) thrones, looking (at all things). On the thrones observing
Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do? Have (not) been rewarded the disbelievers (for) what they used to do
When the heaven is split asunder, When the sky is split asunder
And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so. And has listened to its Lord and was obligated
And when the earth is stretched forth, And when the earth is spread
And has cast out all that was in it and became empty. And has cast out what (is) in it and becomes empty
And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so. And has listened to its Lord and was obligated

O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, and you will meet (the results of your deeds which you did). O mankind Indeed, you (are) laboring to your Lord (with) exertion and you (will) meet Him
Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand, Then as for (him) who is given his record in his right (hand)
He surely will receive an easy reckoning, Then soon his account will be taken an account easy
And will return to his family in joy! And he will return to his people happily
But whosoever is given his Record behind his back, But as for (him) who is given his record behind his back
He will invoke (for his) destruction, Then soon he will call (for) destruction
And he shall enter a blazing Fire, and be made to taste its burning. And he will burn (in) a Blaze
Verily, he was among his people in joy! Indeed, he had been among his people happy
Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)! Indeed, he (had) thought that never he would return
Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him! Yes Indeed his Lord was of him All-Seer
So I swear by the afterglow of sunset; But nay I swear by the twilight glow
And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness, And the night and what it envelops
And by the moon when it is at the full. And the moon when it becomes full
You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter). You will surely embark (to) stage from stage
What is the matter with them, that they believe not? So what (is) for them not they believe
And when the Qur’ân is recited to them, they fall not prostrate. And when is recited to them the Quran not they prostrate
Nay, those who disbelieve belie (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’ân and Islâmic Monotheism, etc.). Nay Those who disbelieved deny
And Allâh knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds), And Allah (is) most knowing of what they keep within themselves
So announce to them a painful torment. so give them tidings of a punishment painful

Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise). Except those who believe and do righteous deeds For them (is) a reward never ending
By the heaven holding the big stars. By the sky containing the constellations
And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection). And the Day Promised
And by the Witnessing day (i.e. Friday), and by the Witnessed day [i.e. the day of ‘Arafât (Hajj) the ninth of Dhul-Hijjah]; And (the) witness and what is witnessed
Cursed were the people of the Ditch (in the story of the Boy and the King). Destroyed were (the) companions (of) the pit
Of fire fed with fuel, (Of) the fire full (of) the fuel
When they sat by it (fire), When they by it (were) sitting
And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them). And they over what they were doing to the believers witnesses
And they had no fault except that they believed in Allâh, the All-Mighty, Worthy of all Praise! And not they resented [of] them except that they believed in Allah the All-Mighty the Praiseworthy

To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allâh is Witness over everything. The One Who for Him (is) the dominion (of) the heavens and the earth and Allah on every thing (is) a Witness

Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance (to Allâh), then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire. Indeed those who persecuted the believing men and the believing women then not they repented then for them (is the) punishment (of) Hell and for them (is the) punishment (of) the Burning Fire

Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success. Indeed those who believe and do the righteous deeds for them (will be) Gardens flow from underneath it the rivers That (is) the success the great
Verily, (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the Seizure (punishment) of your Lord is severe and painful. [See V.11:102]. Indeed (the) Grip (of) your Lord (is) surely strong

Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection). Indeed He He originates and repeats
And He is Oft-Forgiving, full of love (towards the pious who are real true believers of Islâmic Monotheism), And He (is) the Oft-Forgiving the Most Loving
Owner of the throne, the Glorious, Owner (of) the Throne the Glorious
(He is the) Doer of whatsoever He intends (or wills). Doer of what He intends
Has the story reached you of the hosts, Has come to you (the) story (of) the hosts
Of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamûd? Firaun and Thamud
Nay! The disbelievers (persisted) in denying (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his Message of Islâmic Monotheism). Nay Those who disbelieve (are) in denial
And Allâh encompasses them from behind! (i.e. all their deeds are within His Knowledge, and He will requite them for their deeds). But Allah from behind them encompasses
Nay! This is a Glorious Qur’ân, Nay It (is) a Quran Glorious
(Inscribed) in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz (The Preserved Tablet)! In a Tablet Guarded
By the heaven, and At-Târiq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star); By the sky and the night comer
And what will make you to know what At-Târiq (night-comer) is? And what can make you know what the night comer (is)
(It is) the star of piercing brightness; (It is) the star the piercing
There is no human being but has a protector over him (or her) (i.e. angels in charge of each human being guarding him, writing his good and bad deeds) Not (is) every soul but over it (is) a protector
So let man see from what he is created! So let see man from what he is created
He is created from a water gushing forth, He is created from a water ejected
Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs. Coming forth from between the backbone and the ribs
Verily, (Allâh) is Able to bring him back (to life)! Indeed, He to return him (is) Able
The Day when all the secrets (deeds, prayers, fasting, etc.) will be examined (as to their truth). (The) Day will be tested the secrets
Then he will have no power, nor any helper. Then not (is) for him any power and not any helper
By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again. By the sky which returns
And the earth which splits (with the growth of trees and plants). And the earth which cracks open
Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is the Word that separates (the truth from falsehood, and commands strict laws for mankind to cut the roots of evil). Indeed, it (is) surely a Word decisive
And it is not a thing for amusement. And not it (is) for amusement
Verily, they are but plotting a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Indeed, they are plotting a plot
And I (too) am planning a plan. But I am planning a plan
So give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while. So give respite (to) the disbelievers Give respite to them little
Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High, Glorify (the) name (of) your Lord the Most High
Who has created (everything), and then proportioned it. The One Who created then proportioned

And Who has measured (preordainments for everything even to be blessed or wretched); and then guided (i.e. showed mankind the right as well as the wrong paths, and guided the animals to pasture). And the One Who measured then guided
And Who brings out the pasturage, And the One Who brings forth the pasture
And then makes it dark stubble. And then makes it stubble dark
We shall make you to recite (the Qur’ân), so you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) shall not forget (it), We will make you recite so not you will forget
Except what Allâh may will. He knows what is apparent and what is hidden. Except what wills Allah Indeed, He knows the manifest and what is hidden
And We shall make easy for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the easy way (i.e. the doing of righteous deeds). And We will ease you to the ease
Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them). So remind if benefits the reminder
The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allâh), He will pay heed (one) who fears (Allah)
But it will be avoided by the wretched, And will avoid it the wretched one
Who will enter the great Fire (and will be made to taste its burning). The one who will burn (in) the Fire [the] great
There he will neither die (to be in rest) nor live (a good living). Then not he will die therein and not will live
Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islâmic Monotheism) shall achieve success, Certainly has succeeded (one) who purifies (himself)
And remembers (glorifies) the Name of his Lord (worships none but Allâh), and prays (five compulsory prayers and Nawâfil - additional prayers). And remembers (the) name (of) his Lord and prays
Nay, you prefer the life of this world, Nay You prefer the life (of) the world
Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting. While the Hereafter (is) better and everlasting
Verily, this is in the former Scriptures - Indeed this surely (is) in the Scriptures [the] former
The Scriptures of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) and Mûsâ (Moses) (عليهما السلام). (The) Scriptures (of) Ibrahim and Musa
Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)? Has (there) come to you (the) news (of) the Overwhelming
Some faces, that Day will be humiliated (in the Hell-fire, i.e. the faces of all disbelievers, Jews and Christians). Faces that Day (will be) humbled
Labouring (hard in the worldly life by worshipping others besides Allâh), weary (in the Hereafter with humility and disgrace). Laboring exhausted
They will enter in the hot blazing Fire. They will burn (in) a Fire intensely hot
They will be given to drink from a boiling spring, They will be given to drink from a spring boiling
No food will there be for them but a poisonous thorny plant, Not is for them food except from a bitter thorny plant
Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger. Not it nourishes and not it avails from hunger
(Other) faces that Day will be joyful, Faces that Day (will be) joyful
Glad with their endeavour (for their good deeds which they did in this world, along with the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism). With their effort satisfied
In a lofty Paradise. In a garden elevated
Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood. Not they will hear therein vain talk
Therein will be a running spring. Therein (will be) a spring flowing
Therein will be thrones raised high. Therein (will be) thrones raised high
And cups set at hand. And cups put in place
And cushions set in rows. And cushions lined up
And rich carpets (all) spread out. And carpets spread out
Do they not look at the camels, how they are created? Then do not they look towards the camels how they are created
And at the heaven, how it is raised? And towards the sky how it is raised
And at the mountains, how they are rooted (and fixed firm)? And towards the mountains how they are fixed
And at the earth, how it is outspread? And towards the earth how it is spread out
So remind them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) - you are only one who reminds. So remind only you (are) a reminder
You are not a dictator over them - You are not over them a controller
Save the one who turns away and disbelieves. But whoever turns away and disbelieves
Then Allâh will punish him with the greatest punishment. Then will punish him Allah (with) the punishment greatest
Verily, to Us will be their return; Indeed to Us (will be) their return
Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning. Then indeed upon Us (is) their account
By the dawn; By the dawn
By the ten nights (i.e. the first ten days of the month of Dhul-Hijjah), And the nights ten
And by the even and the odd (of all the creations of Allâh). And the even and the odd
And by the night when it departs. And the night when it passes
There is indeed in them (the above oaths) sufficient proofs for men of understanding (and that, they should avoid all kinds of sins and disbeliefs)! Is in that (not) an oath for those who understand
Saw you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) not how your Lord dealt with ‘Âd (people) Did not you see how dealt your Lord with Aad
Of Iram (who were very tall) like (lofty) pillars, Iram possessors (of) lofty pillars
The like of which were not created in the land? Which not had been created like them in the cities
And (with) Thamûd (people), who hewed out rocks in the valley (to make dwellings)? And Thamud who carved out the rocks in the valley
And (with) Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who had the stakes (to torture men by binding them to the stakes)? And Firaun owner of stakes
Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands (in the disobedience of Allâh). Who transgressed in the lands
And made therein much mischief. And (made) much therein corruption
So your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment. So poured on them your Lord scourge (of) punishment
Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful (over them). Indeed your Lord (is) surely Ever Watchful

As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and bounties, then he says (in exultation): "My Lord has honoured me." And as for man when does try him his Lord and is generous to him and favors him he says My Lord has honored me
But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!" But when does He try him and restricts for him his provision then he says My Lord (has) humiliated me
Nay! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity (i.e. you neither treat them well, nor give them their exact right of inheritance)! Nay But not you honor the orphan
And urge not one another on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor)! And not you feel the urge to feed the poor
And you devour the inheritance all with greed. And you consume the inheritance devouring altogether
And you love wealth with much love. And you love wealth (with) love immense
Nay! When the earth is ground to powder. Nay When is leveled the earth pounded (and) crushed
And your Lord comes with the angels in rows. And comes your Lord and the Angels rank (upon) rank

And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance (then) avail him? And is brought that Day Hell That Day will remember man but how (will be) for him the remembrance
He will say: "Alas! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my life!" He will say O I wish I had sent forth for my life
So on that Day none will punish as He will punish. So that Day not will punish (as) His punishment anyone
And none will bind (the wicked, disbelievers and polytheists) as He will bind. And not will bind (as) His binding anyone
(It will be said to the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism): "O (you) the one in (complete) rest and satisfaction! O soul who is satisfied
"Come back to your Lord well-pleased (yourself) and well-pleasing (unto Him)! Return to your Lord well pleased and pleasing
"Enter you then among My (honoured) slaves, So enter among My slaves
"And enter you My Paradise!" And enter My Paradise
I swear by this city (Makkah); Nay I swear by this city
And you are free (from sin, and to punish the enemies of Islâm on the Day of the conquest) in this city (Makkah). And you (are) free (to dwell) in this city
And by the begetter (i.e. Adam عليه السلام) and that which he begot (i.e. his progeny). And the begetter and what he begot
Verily, We have created man in toil. Certainly We have created man (to be) in hardship
Does he think that none can overcome him? Does he think that not has power over him anyone
He says (boastfully): "I have wasted wealth in abundance!" He will say I have squandered wealth abundant
Does he think that none sees him? Does he think that not sees him anyone
Have We not made for him two eyes, Have not We made for him two eyes
And a tongue and two lips? And a tongue and two lips
And shown him the two ways (good and evil)? And shown him the two ways
But he has not attempted to pass on the path that is steep (i.e. the path which will lead to goodness and success). But not he has attempted the steep path
And what will make you know the path that is steep? And what can make you know what the steep path (is)
(It is) freeing a neck (slave) (It is) freeing a neck
Or giving food in a day of hunger (famine), Or feeding in a day of severe hunger
To an orphan near of kin. An orphan of near relationship
Or to a Miskîn (poor) cleaving to dust (out of misery). Or a needy person in misery

Then he became one of those who believed (in the Islamic Monotheism) and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and (also) recommended one another to pity and compassion. Then he is of those who believe and enjoin (each other) to patience and enjoin (each other) to compassion
They are those on the Right Hand (i.e. the dwellers of Paradise), Those (are the) companions (of) the right (hand)

But those who disbelieved in Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell). But those who disbelieve in Our Verses they (are the) companions (of) the left (hand)
The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet. Over them (will be the) Fire closed in
By the sun and its brightness. By the sun and its brightness
By the moon as it follows it (the sun). And the moon when it follows it
By the day as it shows up (the sun’s) brightness. And the day when it displays it
By the night as it conceals it (the sun). And the night when it covers it
By the heaven and Him Who built it. And the heaven and (He) Who constructed it
By the earth and Him Who spread it. And the earth and by (He) Who spread it
By Nafs (Adam or a person or a soul), and Him Who perfected him in proportion; And (the) soul and (He) Who proportioned it
Then He showed him what is wrong for him and what is right for him. And He inspired it (to distinguish) its wickedness and its righteousness

Indeed he succeeds who purifies his ownself (i.e. obeys and performs all that Allâh ordered, by following the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism and by doing righteous good deeds). Indeed he succeeds who purifies it

And indeed he fails who corrupts his ownself (i.e. disobeys what Allâh has ordered by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism or by following polytheism or by doing every kind of evil wicked deeds). And indeed he fails who buries it

Thamûd (people) denied (their Prophet) through their transgression (by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism, and by following polytheism, and by committing every kind of sin). Denied Thamud by their transgression
When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel). When (was) sent forth (the) most wicked of them

But the Messenger of Allâh [Sâlih عليه السلام] said to them: "Be cautious! (Fear the evil end). That is the she-camel of Allâh! (Do not harm it) and bar it not from having its drink!" But said to them (the) Messenger (of) Allah (It is the) she-camel (of) Allah and her drink

Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, and made them equal in destruction (i.e. all grades of people, rich and poor, strong and weak, etc.)! But they denied him and they hamstrung her So destroyed them their Lord for their sin and leveled them
And He (Allâh) feared not the consequences thereof. And not He fears its consequences
By the night as it envelops. By the night when it covers
By the day as it appears in brightness. And the day when it shines in brightness
By Him Who created male and female. And He Who created the male and the female
Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse (different in aims and purposes); Indeed your efforts (are) surely diverse
As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allâh and fears Him, Then as for (him) who gives and fears
And believes in Al-Husnâ. And believes in the best
We will make smooth for him the path of ease (goodness). Then We will ease him towards [the] ease
But he who is greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient. But as for (him) who withholds and considers himself free from need
And belies Al-Husnâ (See the footnote of the Verse No.6) And denies the best
We will make smooth for him the path for evil. Then We will ease him towards [the] difficulty
And what will his wealth avail him when he goes down (in destruction)?. And not will avail him his wealth when he falls
Truly! On Us is (to give) guidance. Indeed upon Us (is) the guidance
And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world). And indeed for Us (is) the Hereafter and the first (life)
Therefore I have warned you of a blazing Fire (Hell). So I warn you (of) a Fire blazing
None shall enter it save the most wretched. Not will burn (in) it except the most wretched
Who denies and turns away. The one who denied and turned away
And Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) will be far removed from it (Hell). But will be removed from it the righteous
He who spends his wealth for increase in self-purification, The one who gives his wealth (to) purify himself
And who has (in mind) no favour from anyone to be paid back, And not for anyone with him any favor to be recompensed
Except to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High. Except seeking (the) Countenance (of) his Lord the Most High
He surely will be pleased (when he enters Paradise). And soon, surely he will be pleased
By the forenoon (after sunrise). By the morning brightness
By the night when it darkens (and stand still). And the night when it covers with darkness
Your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has neither forsaken you nor hates you. Not has forsaken you your Lord and not He is displeased
And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present (life of this world). And surely the Hereafter (is) better for you than the first
And verily, your Lord will give you (all good) so that you shall be well-pleased. And soon will give you your Lord then you will be satisfied
Did He not find you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) an orphan and gave you a refuge? Did not He find you an orphan and give shelter
And He found you unaware (of the Qur’ân, its laws, and Prophethood) and guided you? And He found you lost so He guided
And He found you poor and made you rich (self-sufficient with self-contentment)? And He found you in need so He made self-sufficient
Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression. So as for the orphan then (do) not oppress
And repulse not the beggar. And as for one who asks then (do) not repel
And proclaim the Grace of your Lord (i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces). But as for (the) Favor (of) your Lord narrate
Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)? Have not We expanded for you your breast
And removed from you your burden. And We removed from you your burden
Which weighed down your back? Which weighed upon your back
And have We not raised high your fame? And We raised high for you your reputation
Verily, along with every hardship is relief, So indeed with the hardship (is) ease
Verily, along with every hardship is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs). Indeed with the hardship (is) ease
So when you have finished (your occupation), devote yourself for Allâh’s worship. So when you have finished then labor hard
And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your) intentions and hopes. And to your Lord turn your attention
By the fig, and the olive. By the fig and the olive
By Mount Sinai. And (the) Mount Sinai
By this city of security (Makkah). And this [the] city [the] secure
Verily, We created man in the best stature (mould). Indeed We created man in (the) best mould
Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low. Then We returned him (to the) lowest (of the) low

Save those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds. Then they shall have a reward without end (Paradise). Except those who believe and do righteous deeds then for them (is a) reward never ending
Then what (or who) causes you (O disbelievers) to deny the Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)? Then what causes you to deny after (this) the judgment
Is not Allâh the Best of judges? Is not Allah (the) Most Just (of) the Judges
Read! In the Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists). Read in (the) name (of) your Lord the One Who created
He has created man from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood). He created man from a clinging substance
Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous. Read and your Lord (is) the Most Generous
Who has taught (the writing) by the pen. The One Who taught by the pen
He has taught man that which he knew not. Taught man what not he knew
Nay! Verily, man does transgress (in disbelief and evil deed). Nay Indeed man surely transgresses
Because he considers himself self-sufficient. That he sees himself self-sufficient
Surely, unto your Lord is the return. Indeed to your Lord (is) the return
Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) seen him (i.e. Abû Jahl) who prevents Have you seen the one who forbids
A slave (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when he prays? A slave when he prays
Tell me if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is on the guidance (of Allâh) Have you seen if he is upon [the] guidance
Or enjoins piety! Or he enjoins [of the] righteousness
Tell me if he (Abû Jahl) denies (the truth, i.e. this Qur’ân) and turns away? Have you seen if he denies and turns away
Knows he not that Allâh does see (what he does)? Does not he know that Allah sees
Nay! If he (Abû Jahl) ceases not, We will catch him by the forelock - Nay If not he desists surely We will drag him by the forelock
A lying, sinful forelock! A forelock lying sinful
Then let him call upon his council (of helpers). Then let him call his associates
We will call out the guards of Hell (to deal with him)! We will call the Angels of Hell
Nay! (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)! Do not obey him (Abû Jahl). Fall prostrate and draw near to Allâh! Nay (Do) not obey him But prostrate and draw near (to Allah)
Verily, We have sent it (this Qur’ân) down in the night of Al-Qadr (Decree). Indeed, We revealed it in (the) Night (of) Power
And what will make you know what the night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is? And what can make you know what (the) Night (of) Power (is)

The night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is better than a thousand months (i.e. worshipping Allâh in that night is better than worshipping Him a thousand months, i.e. 83 years and 4 months). (The) Night (of) Power (is) better than a thousand month(s)
Therein descend the angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabrîl)] by Allâh’s Permission with all Decrees, Descend the Angels and the Spirit therein by (the) permission (of) their Lord for every affair
(All that night), there is Peace (and Goodness from Allâh to His believing slaves) until the appearance of dawn. Peace it (is) until (the) emergence (of) the dawn

Those who disbelieve from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikûn, were not going to leave (their disbelief) until there came to them clear evidence. Not were those who disbelieved from (the) People of the Book and the polytheists to be abandoned until (there) comes to them the clear evidence
A Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from Allâh, reciting (the Qur’ân) purified pages [purified from Al-Bâtil (falsehood)]. A Messenger from Allah reciting pages purified
Wherein are correct and straight laws from Allâh. Wherein (are) writings correct

And the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) differed not until after there came to them clear evidence (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever was revealed to him). And not became divided those who were given the Book until from after what came (to) them (of) the clear evidence

And they were commanded not, but that they should worship Allâh, and worship none but Him Alone (abstaining from ascribing partners to Him), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) and give Zakât, and that is the right religion. And not they were commanded except to worship Allah (being) sincere to Him (in) the religion upright and to establish the prayer and to give the zakah And that (is the) religion the correct

Verily, those who disbelieve (in the religion of Islâm, the Qur’ân and Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikûn will abide in the Fire of Hell. They are the worst of creatures. Indeed those who disbelieve from (the) People (of) the Book and the polytheists (will be) in (the) Fire (of) Hell abiding eternally therein Those they (are the) worst (of) the creatures

Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) including all obligations ordered by Islâm] and do righteous good deeds, they are the best of creatures. Indeed those who believe and do righteous deeds those they (are the) best (of) the creatures

Their reward with their Lord is ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity), underneath which rivers flow. They will abide therein forever, Allâh will be pleased with them, and they with Him. That is for him who fears his Lord. Their reward (is) with their Lord Gardens (of) Eternity flow from underneath them the rivers will abide therein forever (will be) pleased Allah with them and they (will be) pleased with Him That (is) for whoever feared his Lord
When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake. When is shaken the earth (with) its earthquake
And when the earth throws out its burdens. And brings forth the earth its burdens
And man will say: "What is the matter with it?" And says man What (is) with it
That Day it will declare its information (about all that happened over it of good or evil). That Day it will report its news
Because your Lord will inspire it. Because your Lord inspired [to] it
That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds. That Day will proceed the mankind (in) scattered groups to be shown their deeds
So whosoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it. So whoever does (equal to the) weight (of) an atom good will see it
And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it. And whoever does (equal to the) weight (of) an atom evil will see it
By the (steeds) that run, with panting. By the racers panting
Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves). And the producers of sparks striking
And scouring to the raid at dawn. And the chargers (at) dawn
And raise the dust in clouds the while. Then raise thereby dust
And penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe). Then penetrate (in the) center thereby collectively
Verily, man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord. Indeed mankind to his Lord (is) surely ungrateful
And to that he bears witness (by his deeds). And indeed, he on that surely (is) a witness
And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth. And indeed he in (the) love (of) wealth (is) surely intense
Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are poured forth (all mankind is resurrected)? But does not he know when will be scattered what (is) in the graves
And that which is in the breasts (of men) is made known? And is made apparent what (is) in the breasts

Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds and will reward them for their deeds). Indeed their Lord about them that Day (is) surely All-Aware
Al-Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour i.e. the Day of Resurrection). The Striking Calamity
What is the striking (Hour)? What (is) the Striking Calamity
And what will make you know what the striking (Hour) is? And what will make you know what (is) the Striking Calamity
It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about. (The) Day will be the mankind like moths scattered
And the mountains will be like carded wool. And will be the mountains like wool fluffed up
Then as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be heavy, Then as for (him) whose (are) heavy his scales
He will live a pleasant life (in Paradise). Then he (will be) in a life pleasant
But as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be light, But as for (him) whose (are) light his scales
He will have his home in Hâwiyah (pit, i.e. Hell). His abode (will be the) Pit
And what will make you know what it is? And what will make you know what it is
(It is) a fiercely blazing Fire! A Fire intensely hot
The mutual rivalry (for piling up of worldly things) diverts you, Diverts you the competition to increase
Until you visit the graves (i.e. till you die). Until you visit the graves
Nay! You shall come to know! Nay Soon you will know
Again nay! You shall come to know! Then nay Soon you will know
Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge (the end result of piling up, you would not have been occupied yourselves in worldly things). Nay If you know (with) a knowledge (of) certainty
Verily, You shall see the blazing Fire (Hell)! Surely you will see the Hellfire
And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight! Then surely you will see it (with the) eye (of) certainty
Then on that Day you shall be asked about the delights (you indulged in, in this world)! Then surely you will be asked that Day about the pleasures
By Al-‘Asr (the time). By the time
Verily, man is in loss, Indeed mankind (is) surely, in loss

Except those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, and recommend one another to the truth [i.e. order one another to perform all kinds of good deeds (Al-Ma‘ruf) which Allâh has ordained, and abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds (Al-Munkar which Allâh has forbidden], and recommend one another to patience (for the sufferings, harms, and injuries which one may encounter in Allâh’s Cause during preaching His religion of Islâmic Monotheism or Jihâd). Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and enjoin (each other) to the truth and enjoin (each other) to [the] patience
Woe to every slanderer and backbiter. Woe to every slanderer backbiter
Who has gathered wealth and counted it. The one who collects wealth and counts it
He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever! Thinking that his wealth will make him immortal
Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire. Nay Surely he will be thrown in the Crusher
And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is? And what will make you know what the Crusher (is)
The fire of Allâh kindled, A Fire Allah kindled
Which leaps up over the hearts, Which mounts up to the hearts
Verily, it shall be closed upon them, Indeed, it (will be) upon them closed over
In pillars stretched forth (i.e. they will be punished in the Fire with pillars). In columns extended

Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) not seen how your Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant? [The Elephant army which came from Yemen under the command of Abrahah Al-Ashram intending to destroy the Ka‘bah at Makkah]. Have not you seen how dealt your Lord with (the) Companions (of the) Elephant
Did He not make their plot go astray? Did not He make their plan go astray
And He sent against them birds, in flocks, And He sent against them birds (in) flocks
Striking them with stones of Sijjîl (baked clay). Striking them with stones of baked clay
And He made them like (an empty field of) stalks (of which the corn has been eaten up by cattle). Then He made them like straw eaten up
(It is a great Grace from Allâh) for the protection of the Quraish, For (the) familiarity (of the) Quraish

(And with all those Allâh’s Grace and Protections, We cause) the (Quraish) caravans to set forth safe in winter (to the south) and in summer (to the north without any fear), Their familiarity (with the) journey (of) winter and summer
So let them worship (Allâh) the Lord of this House (the Ka‘bah in Makkah), So let them worship (the) Lord (of) this House
(He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear. The One Who feeds them [from] (against) hunger and gives them security from fear
Have you seen him who denies the Recompense? Have you seen the one who denies the Judgment
That is he who repulses the orphan (harshly), Then that (is) the one who repulses the orphan
And urges not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor), And (does) not feel the urge to feed the poor
So woe unto those performers of Salât (prayers) (hypocrites), So woe to those who pray
Those who delay their Salât (prayer from their stated fixed times). Those who [they] about their prayers (are) neglectful
Those who do good deeds only to be seen (of men), Those who [they] make show
And prevent Al-Mâ‘ûn (small kindnesses like salt, sugar, water). And they deny [the] small kindnesses
Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise). Indeed, We We have given you Al-Kauthar
Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only). So pray to your Lord and sacrifice
For he who hates you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), he will be cut off (from posterity and every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter). Indeed your enemy he (is) the one cut off

Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to these Mushrikûn and Kâfirûn): "O Al-Kafirûn (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, in His Angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Resurrection, and in Al-Qadar)! Say O disbelievers
"I worship not that which you worship, Not I worship what you worship
"Nor will you worship that which I worship. And not you (are) worshippers (of) what I worship
"And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping. And not I am a worshipper (of) what you worship
"Nor will you worship that which I worship. And not you (are) worshippers (of) what I worship
"To you be your religion, and to me my religion (Islâmic Monotheism)." For you (is) your religion and for me (is) my religion
When there comes the Help of Allâh (to you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم against your enemies) and the conquest (of Makkah). When comes (the) Help (of) Allah and the Victory
And you see that the people enter Allah’s religion (Islâm) in crowds. And you see the people entering into (the) religion (of) Allah (in) multitudes

So glorify the Praises of your Lord, and ask His Forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and Who forgives. Then glorify with (the) praises (of) your Lord and ask His forgiveness Indeed, He is Oft-Returning
Perish the two hands of Abû Lahab (an uncle of the Prophet) and perish he! Perish (the) hands (of) Abu Lahab and perish he
His wealth and his children will not benefit him! Not (will) avail him his wealth and what he earned
He will be burnt in a Fire of blazing flames! He will be burnt (in) a Fire of Blazing Flames
And his wife, too, who carries wood (thorns of Sa‘dân which she used to put on the way of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, or use to slander him). And his wife (the) carrier (of) firewood
In her neck is a twisted rope of Masad (palm fibre). In her neck (will be) a rope of palm-fiber
Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "He is Allâh, (the) One. Say He (is) Allah the One
"Allâh-us-Samad (السيد الذي يصمد إليه في الحاجات) [Allâh the Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, (He neither eats nor drinks)]. Allah the Eternal, the Absolute
"He begets not, nor was He begotten. Not He begets and not He is begotten
"And there is none co-equal or comparable unto Him." And not is for Him equivalent any [one]
Say: "I seek refuge with (Allâh), the Lord of the daybreak, Say I seek refuge in (the) Lord (of) the dawn
"From the evil of what He has created, From (the) evil (of) what He created
"And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness; (or the moon as it sets or goes away), And from (the) evil (of) darkness when it spreads
"And from the evil of those who practise witchcraft when they blow in the knots, And from (the) evil (of) the blowers in the knots
"And from the evil of the envier when he envies." And from (the) evil (of) an envier when he envies
Say: "I seek refuge with (Allâh) the Lord of mankind, Say I seek refuge in (the) Lord (of) mankind
"The King of mankind - (The) King (of) mankind
"The Ilâh (God) of mankind, (The) God (of) mankind

"From the evil of the whisperer (devil who whispers evil in the hearts of men) who withdraws (from his whispering in one’s heart after one remembers Allâh). From (the) evil (of) the whisperer the one who withdraws
"Who whispers in the breasts of mankind. The one who whispers in (the) breasts (of) mankind
"Of jinn and men." From the jinn and men
